Next month you ask Sam to move some heavy boxes. Sam is free that day and would be able to do it. For this question, take Sam's availability and physical ability at that future time as given, regardless of any earlier limitation. Which is more likely?
(A) Sam would decline.
(B) Sam would agree to help.
Return a JSON object with exactly two fields in this order: "brief_basis", a brief explanation (one or two sentences) for your answer using the supplied information; then "answer", whose value is A or B. Do not include other fields.
binary_review.brief_basis: Despite being physically able this time, Sam experienced failure and likely embarrassment when unable to help previously due to the bad shoulder. This negative past experience would make Sam hesitant to commit to a similar request, even if the physical limitation no longer applies.
